maria_sales: Hey team — customer (FinSight) wants a short POC later this week. They expect a 30m demo with ~150 r/s peak, mostly short chat completions (max tokens ~300) hitting the hosted API. Can we provision a temporary throughput bump and a scoped API key for the demo window? Need IP allowlist and audit logs enabled.

ahmed_se: Got it. Can you confirm the exact window (UTC)? Also which model they want pinned? Hosted vs Dedicated? If it's a one-off demo 150 r/s for 30m we can probably do hosted with a temp quota increase + scoped key.

maria_sales: Demo is Fri 2026-04-10 16:00-16:40 UTC. Model requested: redwood/longchat-13b (they chose for cost/latency). Hosted is preferred — customer doesn't want Dedicated right now.

ahmed_se: That works. Two operational asks: 1) scoped API key with limited routes + IP allowlist for their demo IPs; 2) temporary quota bump to 160 r/s with burst headroom to 200 for 10m in case of demos. Billing note: we flag as temporary and bill for usage at standard hosted rates.

lisa_security: Quick security note — scoped keys + IP allowlist ok for demo. We need the security questionnaire signed and we must confirm no PHI/PII in prompts for the session. Also set logs retention to 90 days and enable KMS-wrapped key for any customer-provided secrets. If they require longer retention or on-prem, that's a different path.

maria_sales: They're fine with 90 days. They passed the basic questionnaire but asked about SSO for team afterwards. For the demo we just need the scoped key.

ahmed_se: I'll prepare the key. Suggest we create an ephemeral scoped key expiring 24h post-demo and attach a named policy: allow: /v1/chat.completions, /v1/embeddings (read) with rate_override: 160 r/s, burst: 200 for 10m; IP allowlist: 203.0.113.45/32 and 198.51.100.22/32. Example config I will apply: ```json
{
  "policy_name": "finsight-demo-20260410",
  "routes": ["/v1/chat.completions"],
  "rate_override": 160,
  "burst_window_seconds": 600,
  "ip_allowlist": ["203.0.113.45/32","198.51.100.22/32"],
  "expires_at": "2026-04-11T16:00:00Z"
}
```

ops_bot: Deploy task queued: create-scoped-key(finsight-demo-20260410) by @ahmed_se. CI run id: deploy-52231.

ahmed_se: FYI will also pin model to redwood/longchat-13b@v2.1 for the window to avoid autoswitches. Running a small canary on a test key now.

maria_sales: Do we need to change any quotas for their account on our billing side or just the token QPS? Sales ops needs a cost estimate to share with customer.

ahmed_se: I'll estimate. For 30m demo at ~150 r/s, tokens per completion ~400 (input+output), so ~3.6M tokens. With our hosted rate that's roughly $X (placeholder) — I'll compute and post a line item. Also note: if we see sustained usage >30m we may throttle to baseline; will notify.

lisa_security: Approve scoped key + IP allowlist for this window. Please ensure the key is revoked after 24h and that we capture the security questionnaire approval email in the ticket.

maria_sales: Perfect. Ahmed — please create ticket in sales-poc with final cost estimate and attach the signed questionnaire. I'll share the scoped key with customer in a secure channel once ops_bot confirms creation. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Success: scoped key finsight-demo-20260410 created by ahmed_se. Expires at 2026-04-11T16:00:00Z. Access URL: https://console.redwood.ai/keys/finsight-demo-20260410 (admins only).

ahmed_se: Key created and pinned model locked. Cost estimate posted in ticket #POC-8819. I also added fallback policy to reduce rate to 40 r/s if backend errors exceed 5% for >2m.

maria_sales: Thanks — closing loop. I'll send confirmation to FinSight and include the POC runbook & safety checklist.

ahmed_se: Available for run-of-show if needed on Fri.

lisa_security: Leaving a note in the customer file re: SSO follow-up.

maria_sales: Done. Thread closed after confirmations.
